title: Level of water stress by country (SDG 6.4.2, FAO AQUASTAT)
referencePeriod: Latest year per country, 2021–2022; series from 2000
coverage: 178 countries with a value; 39 World Bank economies without one (listed)
attribution: FAO AQUASTAT, via World Bank World Development Indicators (ER.H2O.FWST.ZS), CC BY 4.0

retrieval.method: World Bank API v2 (fetch-reference --set stage6, GitHub Actions)
retrieval.notes: API last updated 2026-10-08. Values as published (rounded to 3 decimals); classes from FAO's SDG 6.4.2 thresholds. A national figure for the whole country.
